verdicts.reason: In both, the purple circle has moved off the can and now sits behind the quote and attribution, so it no longer frames the product. The logo strip is also enlarged and crowds the bottom-left corner. A spaces the attribution comfortably below the quote and centres the can against the text block, though the can floats with no backing shape. B jams 'THE ULTRA TASTING TEAM' right under the last quote line, pins the can high against the quote's top edge and leaves a large empty band below the text, so its spacing is worse.
